subject: [AMBER] tleap - extract ion molecules and save it as pdb

messages.author: HOCHEOL LIM
messages.body:
Dear All,
Hello,
I am generating ion molecules with addions2 command. I would like to extract only ion molecules and save it as pdb format.
What should I do?

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Jun 10, 2020, HOCHEOL LIM wrote:
>
>I am generating ion molecules with addions2 command. I would like to
>extract only ion molecules and save it as pdb format.
Save you UNIT as a pdb file (savePdb); then use grep to pull out the
ions.
(Perhaps not the only solution, but the one that I would use.)
...dac

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
One way would be to save the topology and coords (or pdb or mol2) in leap,
read them into cpptraj and strip all but the ions (e.g. ‘strip !(Na+)’),
write to output pdb (‘trajout ions.pdb’).
-Dan
